audit_entry_form.aef_subtxt: The tool evaluates websites based on efficiency, sustainability, accessibility, and security. In the last {{time}} hours, {{requests}} new audits have been performed. Requests are limited to {{limit}} per {{time}} hours.

card_1.title: Digital Carbon Footprint
card_1.text: Digital technologies account for around 4% of global greenhouse gas emissions. That is comparable to the emissions of the entire aviation industry.

card_2.title: Speed Matters
card_2.text: 53% of mobile users leave a website if it takes longer than 3 seconds to load. A fast site keeps visitors and saves energy.

card_3.title: Accessibility Gaps
card_3.text: 96% of the most visited websites have detectable accessibility errors. Fixing just a few common issues would make the web significantly more inclusive.

card_4.title: Images Dominate Page Weight
card_4.text: Images account for around 40% of a typical web page's total data volume. Optimized formats reduce bandwidth and energy use with every page view.

card_5.title: Encryption as Standard
card_5.text: Over 90% of browsing time in Chrome is now spent on HTTPS-secured pages. An encrypted connection is the basic requirement for user trust.

card_6.title: Performance Affects Rankings
card_6.text: Google uses Core Web Vitals as an official ranking factor. A faster, leaner website directly improves visibility in search results.

card_7.title: Unused JavaScript
card_7.text: On average, around 44% of JavaScript downloaded by mobile browsers is never used during the page load. Removing unused code is one of the fastest ways to improve performance.

card_8.title: Third-Party Scripts
card_8.text: Over 94% of web pages load at least one third-party script. These external resources are among the leading causes of slow page load times.

card_9.title: Water and Data Centers
card_9.text: Data centers consume large amounts of water for cooling. A sustainable hosting provider considers both the energy source and the water footprint of its infrastructure.

card_10.title: Small Businesses as Targets
card_10.text: 43% of cyberattacks target small businesses. Regular security audits help identify vulnerabilities before they can be exploited.

card_11.title: Video Dominates Traffic
card_11.text: Video streaming accounts for over 65% of global internet traffic. Efficient compression and lazy loading reduce the CO2 impact of every page view.

card_12.title: Mobile First
card_12.text: Around 60% of global web traffic comes from mobile devices. Efficient code saves not only data but also battery life for users on the go.

card_13.title: Accessibility as a Market
card_13.text: People with disabilities and their families represent significant purchasing power. Accessible websites reach an audience that inaccessible ones simply exclude.

card_14.title: Web Font Costs
card_14.text: Web fonts are a common cause of slow loading times. Using modern WOFF2 format instead of older formats can reduce font file sizes by around 30%.

card_15.title: Dark Mode on OLED
card_15.text: At full screen brightness, dark mode can reduce display power use by up to 47% on OLED screens. The saving under typical auto-brightness conditions is 3 to 9%.

card_16.title: The Cost of Page Bloat
card_16.text: The median web page now weighs over 2.6 MB on desktop — more than the original Doom game from 1993. Leaner pages load faster and consume less energy.

card_17.title: CO2 per Page View
card_17.text: The average web page produces around 0.5g of CO2 per page view. For a site with 100,000 monthly visitors, that adds up to 50 kg of CO2 per month.

card_18.title: Security Headers
card_18.text: A Content Security Policy (CSP) header prevents cross-site scripting attacks. Yet many websites still do not implement basic HTTP security headers.

card_19.title: Green Hosting
card_19.text: The Green Web Foundation tracks hosting providers that run on renewable energy. Choosing a green host is one of the most direct ways to reduce a website's carbon footprint.

card_20.title: SEO and Accessibility Overlap
card_20.text: Many accessibility improvements also benefit SEO. Proper heading structure, image alt text, and descriptive links help both screen readers and search engine crawlers.

card_21.title: JavaScript Growth
card_21.text: The median JavaScript payload on mobile pages has grown steadily year over year. More code means more energy spent on parsing and execution with every visit.

card_22.title: 1-Second Delay
card_22.text: A 1-second delay in page load time can reduce conversions by up to 7%. Performance is not just an environmental issue — it directly affects business results.

card_23.title: HTTPS and Phishing
card_23.text: Over 90% of phishing sites now use HTTPS. A padlock icon alone is not a sign of trustworthiness — domain reputation checks are equally important.

card_24.title: Low Contrast Text
card_24.text: Low contrast text is the most common accessibility error, found on 84% of home pages. It is also one of the easiest to fix with a simple CSS adjustment.

card_25.title: Data Center Energy
card_25.text: Global data centers consumed around 900 TWh of electricity in 2025 — roughly 2.7% of all global electricity use. The figure is set to grow with rising AI demand.

audit_error_msg.msg_1: The analysis may have failed because access by the serverless function (AWS Lambda) was blocked by IP filters or security rules of the hosting provider.
